caveats: Region grid: 60x60 cells (lat 61.58-62.76 N, lon 20.18-21.36 E, 0.02 deg grid). 3308 of 3600 cells are sea cells (SST finite on all 92 target days). Threshold/climatology per day-of-year from 1992-2002 baseline with +-5 calendar-day windows (121 pool values per day of year, incl. 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 edge days), 90th percentile computed with numpy method='hazen', climatology = pool mean, day 60 set to mean of days 59 and 61, then 31-day centred wrap-around moving mean. Per-cell MHW: runs of >=5 consecutive hot days (SST >= threshold); MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days are joined, gap days included. 2021 was a strongly warm summer in this region (~4-6 K above baseline), producing extended MHW activity.
